title: Beyond the Horizon
body:
# WELCOME!
![Custom Village](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d216d3747ef04a8dcb24bbe99c6544e85ec70225.jpeg)

(shader used = 
Merlin1809 / Eclipse-Shader , here's the link: https://github.com/Merlin1809/Eclipse-Shader)
> ## GOAL:
The goal of the Modpack is to create an immersive adventure for those who use and don't use shaders.
> ## WHAT DOES IT OFFER:
This is a fully optimized Modpack and features:
- Many new biomes
- Many new structures
- Several adventure mods
- New Mobs
- New animations
- Custom shaders
- Custom sounds
- Multyplayer compatibility (cracked also!)
> ## CONFIGURATION:
- Remember to use the Resource Packs! (you may encounter problems of compatibility, try using 
Enchanting Table Magic Circle at the top of the list)
- If possible take the RAM usage from 2GB to half of your total RAM (we raccomand using 8GB of RAM at least)
- If you feel slower than you shuld try to disable VSyinc.


> ### NOTES:
- Keep in mind that this is a fairly large Modpack, but you'll have no problem running it without shaders!
- When you feel like your world is big enough disable "Voxy World Gen" from the "mod menu" settings!
- If you are not sure how you PC will handle the Modpack, try running it _without_ shaders at start, remember to check the configuration settings!
